children.title: Metacognitive Monitoring for Unrecognized Reasoning Limits

detail.title: Metacognitive Monitoring for Unrecognized Reasoning Limits
detail.summary: Reasoning limits are implicitly defined by the operational boundaries of the information collector itself. While multi-agent frameworks can mitigate single-model biases, the 'trusted collector' mechanism acts as a hard boundary for evidence acquisition, potentially creating unrecognized blind spots in domains where physical/sensorimotor grounding is absent.
detail.reason: Incorporates the collector source code as evidence of the boundary within which reasoning occurs.
